name: Sorrento (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sorrento (white lozenges on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Sorrento, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 20 September 1928.

features.role: Sorrento arms — white lozenges on red, crowned, within branches
